verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents an official hosted remote MCP server that lets agents run read-only and read-write SQL, explore schemas, and read and write Guides, with a read-only restriction option. It also ships an official local MCP server (mcp-server-motherduck) on GitHub, and a getting-started guide shows how to connect an agent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of agent connections working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote:
With the remote MCP server, your agent can:
- Execute read-only and read-write SQL against your databases
- Explore database schemas, tables, and columns
The MotherDuck remote MCP Server lets you analyze your data using natural language and generate interactive visualizations, all without writing SQL.
Local MCP server for DuckDB and MotherDuck
Your agents can now INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, create tables, and modify schemas through the MCP — not just SELECT.
To restrict your AI assistant to read-only access, see Restricting to read-only access
